permitDetails.facilityName: JP Morgan Chase & Co. Core Data Center II
permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause: Representatives of the Department may. At any reasonable tie, inspect this facility
permitDetails.extractionNotes: Permit identifier appears in multiple formats in the document, including 'APC-2003/0284-OPERATION (Amendment 3)(SM)(MACT)' (letter subject and memorandum) and 'APC-2003/0284-O(SM)(MACT)(A3)' (emission unit inspection report header). Selected the fully spelled 'Amendment 3' form. Facility name taken from memorandum headers ('JP Morgan Chase & Co. Core Data Center II'). Address taken from memorandum ('4001 Governor Printz Blvd Wilmington, DE 19802-2310'). No explicit permit issuance or expiration dates stated. County not stated. Condition 7.2 states 'This permit shall be made available on the premises' and was used for permitCopyOnsiteRequired. Condition 1.2 used for rightOfEntryClause. Condition 5.2.8 references an initial notification required by 7 DE Admin. Code 1144 ('upon installation'), but the permit does not explicitly state a startup notification window; startup/construction notification fields left null.

generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: An emergency generator may operate only during an emergency as defined below: The emergency generators shall not be operated in conjunction with a voluntary demand-reduction program or any other interruptible power supply arrangement with a utility, other market participant, or system operator (e.g. Delmarva Power, Delaware Electric Cooperative, PJM, etc.). Maintenance checks and readiness testing of such units is limited to 100 hours per year.
generatorSets.observationFrequency: Once a quarter the emergency generators shall be observed for the presence or absence of visible emissions for at least five minutes while the equipment is operating.
generatorSets.extractionNotes: Unit reference taken from Condition 4.6 comment list ('DG-1: 1622.9; ... DG-8: 1601.8'). No make/model or capacity data stated in the provided document. Fuel type and combined throughput limit from Condition 3.1.1. Per-unit operating hours limit and rolling window from Condition 3.1.2. Sulfur content limit from Condition 3.1.3. Fuel supplier certification requirement from Condition 5.2.6. Allowed operating modes excerpted from Conditions 3.9, 3.10, and the 100-hour maintenance/testing limit from Condition 3.8. Opacity limit from Condition 2.2. Visible emissions observation frequency from Condition 4.2.1. Record retention from Condition 5.1. MACT ZZZZ applicability from 'Applicable Regulations'.
